title: Normal daily batch
what: New PO lines (CSV) and invoices (Parquet) for 2026-11-02
expect: Loaded on the next 10-minute batch run. No DQ errors. Incremental models pick up only new rows.

title: Risk stream: normal events + one spike
what: 5 NDJSON files of risk score events; one supplier jumps to score 8
expect: Each file lands within about a minute (Snowpipe). RISK_CURRENT updates; the spike raises HIGH_RISK and SCORE_JUMP alerts.

title: Exact duplicate file
what: The wave-1 PO file delivered again in a 'redelivery' folder: same name, same content
expect: It lands in RAW (unique stage path), AUD-F02 flags it, dbt dedup keeps one row per PO line.

title: Same content, different name
what: The wave-1 PO file resent as *_resend.csv
expect: Snowflake load history cannot catch this. AUD-F04 (same MD5) flags it; RAW has duplicates; staging dedups.

title: Same name, different content
what: Corrected PO file and a risk file re-sent with the SAME file names as before, new content
expect: With unique stage paths both land (no silent skip). AUD-F03 flags them; staging keeps the latest AEDAT/load.

title: Bad rows
what: PO file with an extra delimiter, text in an amount, a missing supplier, an invalid date, bad encoding
expect: Whole file still lands (all VARCHAR, ON_ERROR=CONTINUE). Row rules flag the 5 rows; dbt quarantines them.

title: Late, changed and deleted records
what: Invoices posted in September arriving now; PO lines changed or deleted (new AEDAT)
expect: Incremental models must use a lookback window or late rows are missed; staging keeps latest AEDAT.

title: Supplier master changes
what: Full reload of the vendor master: names, addresses, bank accounts changed, 2 newly blocked, 1 new duplicate
expect: dbt snapshot creates new SCD2 versions; golden record merges the new duplicate by VAT.

title: Schema drift
what: PO file with a renamed column and a new column; risk events with payload_version 2
expect: Data still lands (header row kept, extra column in _EXTRA_1). AUD-S01 flags drift; stream handles v2.

title: Contract and sourcing updates
what: Contract deltas (amendments, terminations, soft delete), events completed, 12 new requests in 3 pages
expect: Snapshots capture status history; soft deletes excluded; new pages flattened.

title: Empty, header-only and bulk files
what: A 0-byte file, a header-only file, and a bulk file with 19354 PO lines
expect: Empty files are logged, not errors. Volume check warns on the bulk file. Python reads it in chunks.

title: Stream chaos + manual Excel + FX
what: Out-of-order, duplicate, late and invalid risk events; a 500-event burst; new savings Excel; November FX
expect: Dead letter gets 4 invalid events + 1 duplicate; the out-of-order event does not overwrite the newer score; the late event is flagged.
